ruling.author: velvetmonkey
ruling.scope: Ben ruled approve on 2026-09-04 at 23:20. The duplicate-key gate control failed twice in CI this week with a bare 1 !== 0, a message that could not distinguish a harmless torn read from a real gate bypass. contract/fixtures/counting-child.cjs is an EXECUTABLE test child, not a recorded data fixture. It opened its count file with mode w, which truncates, so a concurrent reader could observe an empty string and Number("") is 0. This ruling authorises replacing that write with a same-directory temporary file and a rename, following the repository idiom in spine/protection.cjs, and nothing else. No recorded fixture data changed. The assertion in test/spine-retry.test.cjs still compares Number(readCount(countFile)) - baseline against 0; only a third message argument was added. No sleep, timeout or retry count moved. A cold frisk on grok-4.6, cross-family against builder gpt-5.6-luna, forced a real gate bypass by deleting the return after decideGuarded in spine/proxy.cjs and confirmed the test still goes RED and names the cause.
retires: The 2026-08-31 ruling on test/dist-pin.test.cjs, test/installed-tree-pin-manifest-review.test.cjs and the third run-scoped temporary-root file, base 4c736b43060db66754c48482a7d47b1895e28297, which landed and no longer applies to any open change.
